SELECT SEQ, EMPID, LOCAL_NAME, PHONE, BANK_NO, DEPTNO, GET_DEPT_NAME(DEPTNO,#interLanguage#) DEPT_NAME, ID_CARD_NO, DOB, TRUNC(MONTHS_BETWEEN(SYSDATE,TO_DATE(DOB,'YYYYMMDD'))/12) AGE, SEXCODE, GET_GLOBAL_NAME(SEXCODE,#interLanguage#) SEXCODE_NAME, EMP_OFFICE, GET_GLOBAL_NAME(EMP_OFFICE,#interLanguage#) EMP_OFFICE_NAME, DATE_STARTED, DATE_LEFT, ACTIVITY, TO_CHAR(UPDATE_DATE, 'YYYY.MM.DD HH24:MI') UPDATE_DATE, GET_UPDATED_INFO(UPDATED_BY) UPDATED_BY, GET_UPDATED_INFO(CONFIRM_BY) CONFIRM_BY FROM HR_TEMP_EMPLOYEE HR WHERE HR.CPNY_ID = #interCpnyID#
EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM HR_DEPARTMENT WHERE HR_DEPARTMENT.DEPTNO = HR.DEPTNO START WITH HR_DEPARTMENT.DEPTNO = #DEPTNO# CONNECT BY PRIOR HR_DEPARTMENT.DEPTNO = HR_DEPARTMENT.PARENT_DEPT_NO )
EXISTS (SELECT B1.DEPTID FROM HR_DEPARTMENT B1 WHERE B1.DEPTNO = HR.DEPTNO START WITH B1.DEPTNO in (SELECT HRD.DEPTID FROM HR_DEPARTMENT HRD WHERE HRD.MANAGER_EMP_ID = #adminID:VARCHAR#) CONNECT BY PRIOR B1.DEPTNO = B1.PARENT_DEPT_NO UNION SELECT AR_SUPERVISOR_INFO.DEPTNO FROM AR_SUPERVISOR_INFO WHERE AR_SUPERVISOR_INFO.DEPTNO = HR.DEPTNO AND AR_SUPERVISOR_INFO.PERSON_ID = #adminID:VARCHAR# )
( EMPID LIKE UPPER('%$KEY$%') OR LOCAL_NAME LIKE UPPER('%$KEY$%') )
SEQ = #SEQ#
EMP_OFFICE = #EMP_OFFICE#
ACTIVITY = #ACTIVITY:VARCHAR#
DATE_STARTED >= REPLACE(#START_DATE#,'.','')
DATE_STARTED <= REPLACE(#END_DATE#,'.','')
ORDER BY SEQ DESC

( HR.EMPID LIKE UPPER('%$KEY$%') OR HR.LOCAL_NAME LIKE UPPER('%$KEY$%') )

SHOP.CHANGE_DATE >= #START_DATE#

sqlMap.insert: MERGE INTO ESS_CHANGE_SHOP T1 USING (SELECT #PERSON_ID# PERSON_ID, #CHANGE_DATE# CHANGE_DATE FROM DUAL) T2 ON (T1.PERSON_ID = T2.PERSON_ID AND T1.CHANGE_DATE = T2.CHANGE_DATE) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET T1.DEPTNO = GET_CODE_NO(#DEPTNAME:VARCHAR#,'0',#interCpnyID:VARCHAR#,'DEPT'), T1.SHIFT_FROM_TIME = #SHIFT_FROM_TIME:VARCHAR#, T1.SHIFT_TO_TIME = NVL(#SHIFT_TO_TIME:VARCHAR#,#CHANGE_DATE#), T1.CHANGE_TYPE = DECODE(#CHANGE_TYPE:VARCHAR#,'临时','1','正式','2','1'), UPDATE_DATE = SYSDATE, UPDATED_BY = #adminID:VARCHAR#, UPDATED_IP = #adminIP:VARCHAR#, ACTIVITY = DECODE(#CHANGE_TYPE:VARCHAR#,'临时','1','正式','0','1'), OLD_DEPTNO = #OLD_DEPTNO:VARCHAR#, CONFIRM_FLAG = 0 WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT ( SEQ, PERSON_ID, CHANGE_DATE, DEPTNO, SHIFT_FROM_TIME, SHIFT_TO_TIME, CREATE_DATE, CREATED_BY, CREATED_IP, UPDATE_DATE, UPDATED_BY, UPDATED_IP, ACTIVITY, CHANGE_TYPE, OLD_DEPTNO, CONFIRM_FLAG ) VALUES (ESS_CHANGE_SHOP_SEQ.NEXTVAL, #PERSON_ID:VARCHAR#, #CHANGE_DATE:VARCHAR#, GET_CODE_NO(#DEPTNAME:VARCHAR#,'0',#interCpnyID:VARCHAR#,'DEPT'), #SHIFT_FROM_TIME:VARCHAR#, NVL(#SHIFT_TO_TIME:VARCHAR#,#CHANGE_DATE#), SYSDATE, #adminID:VARCHAR#, #adminIP:VARCHAR#, SYSDATE, #adminID:VARCHAR#, #adminIP:VARCHAR#, DECODE(#CHANGE_TYPE:VARCHAR#,'临时','1','正式','0','1'), DECODE(#CHANGE_TYPE:VARCHAR#,'临时','1','正式','2','1'), #OLD_DEPTNO:VARCHAR#, 0)

UPDATE HR_EMP_HISTORY_STATUS HR SET HR.SHOP_DEPT_NO = GET_CODE_NO(#DEPTNAME:VARCHAR#,'0',#interCpnyID:VARCHAR#,'DEPT') WHERE HR.PERSON_ID = #PERSON_ID# AND HR.DATE_STR BETWEEN TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(#CHANGE_DATE#,'YYYY.MM.DD'),'YYYY/MM/DD') AND TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(NVL(#SHIFT_TO_TIME:VARCHAR#,#CHANGE_DATE#),'YYYY.MM.DD'),'YYYY/MM/DD') AND DECODE(#CHANGE_TYPE:VARCHAR#,'临时','1','正式','2','1') = '1'

UPDATE HR_EMP_HISTORY_STATUS HR SET HR.SHOP_DEPT_NO = HR.DEPTNO WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ESS_CHANGE_SHOP ESS WHERE ESS.SEQ = #SEQ# AND ESS.PERSON_ID = HR.PERSON_ID AND HR.DATE_STR BETWEEN TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(CHANGE_DATE,'YYYY.MM.DD'),'YYYY/MM/DD') AND TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(NVL(SHIFT_TO_TIME,CHANGE_DATE),'YYYY.MM.DD'),'YYYY/MM/DD') )

SELECT HE.EMPID, HE.PERSON_ID, HE.DEPTNO, HE.LOCAL_NAME, GET_DEPT_NAME(HE.DEPTNO,#interLanguage:VARCHAR#) DEPT_NAME, HE.MAIN_BUSINESS, GET_CODE_NAME(HE.POST_GRADE_NO,#interLanguage:VARCHAR#) POST_GRADE, GET_CODE_NAME(HE.EMP_OFFICE,#interLanguage:VARCHAR#) EMP_OFFICE_NAME FROM HR_EMPLOYEE HE,SY_CODE SC WHERE HE.CPNY_ID = #interCpnyID:VARCHAR# AND HE.POST_GRADE_NO = SC.CODE_NO(+) AND HE.EMPID NOT LIKE '111111%'

( HE.EMPID LIKE upper('%' || #KEY:VARCHAR# || '%' ) OR HE.LOCAL_NAME LIKE upper('%' || #KEY:VARCHAR# || '%' ) OR upper(HE.CHINESE_PINYIN) LIKE upper('%' || #KEY:VARCHAR# || '%' ) OR upper(HE.ENGLISH_NAME) LIKE upper('%' || #KEY:VARCHAR# || '%' ) )

FROM HR_EMPLOYEE HR WHERE HR.POST_FAMILY IN ('14015815','14015816') AND HR.CPNY_ID = #interCpnyID# AND (HR.DATE_LEFT IS NULL OR HR.DATE_LEFT > TO_DATE(#MONTH#||'/01','YYYY/MM/DD')) AND HR.DATE_STARTED < ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(#MONTH#||'/01','YYYY/MM/DD'),1) AND HR.PERSON_ID NOT LIKE '111111%'
( HR.EMPID LIKE UPPER('%$KEY$%') OR HR.LOCAL_NAME LIKE UPPER('%$KEY$%') )
HR.DEPTNO IN ($DEPTNO_Multi$)
EXISTS (SELECT B1.DEPTID FROM HR_DEPARTMENT B1 WHERE B1.DEPTNO = HR.DEPTNO START WITH B1.DEPTNO in (SELECT HRD.DEPTID FROM HR_DEPARTMENT HRD WHERE HRD.MANAGER_EMP_ID = #adminID:VARCHAR#) CONNECT BY PRIOR B1.DEPTNO = B1.PARENT_DEPT_NO UNION SELECT AR_SUPERVISOR_INFO.DEPTNO FROM AR_SUPERVISOR_INFO WHERE AR_SUPERVISOR_INFO.DEPTNO = HR.DEPTNO AND AR_SUPERVISOR_INFO.PERSON_ID = #adminID:VARCHAR# )
ORDER BY HR.DEPTNO,HR.EMPID

FROM HR_EMPLOYEE HR WHERE HR.POST_FAMILY IN ($postFamily$) AND HR.CPNY_ID = #interCpnyID# AND (HR.DATE_LEFT IS NULL OR HR.DATE_LEFT > TO_DATE(#MONTH#||'/01','YYYY/MM/DD')) AND HR.DATE_STARTED < ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(#MONTH#||'/01','YYYY/MM/DD'),1) AND HR.PERSON_ID NOT LIKE '111111%'
( HR.EMPID LIKE UPPER('%$KEY$%') OR HR.LOCAL_NAME LIKE UPPER('%$KEY$%') )
HR.DEPTNO = #DEPTNO#
EXISTS (SELECT B1.DEPTID FROM HR_DEPARTMENT B1 WHERE B1.DEPTNO = HR.DEPTNO START WITH B1.DEPTNO in (SELECT HRD.DEPTID FROM HR_DEPARTMENT HRD WHERE HRD.MANAGER_EMP_ID = #adminID:VARCHAR#) CONNECT BY PRIOR B1.DEPTNO = B1.PARENT_DEPT_NO UNION SELECT AR_SUPERVISOR_INFO.DEPTNO FROM AR_SUPERVISOR_INFO WHERE AR_SUPERVISOR_INFO.DEPTNO = HR.DEPTNO AND AR_SUPERVISOR_INFO.PERSON_ID = #adminID:VARCHAR# )
ORDER BY HR.DEPTNO,HR.EMPID

MERGE INTO AR_SHOP_SHIFT T1 USING (SELECT #PERSON_ID# PERSON_ID, #AR_DATE_STR# AR_DATE_STR FROM DUAL) T2 ON (T1.PERSON_ID = T2.PERSON_ID AND T1.AR_DATE_STR = T2.AR_DATE_STR) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET T1.SHIFT_FROM_TIME = #SHIFT_FROM_TIME#, T1.SHIFT_TO_TIME = #SHIFT_TO_TIME#, T1.MINUS_LENGTH = #MINUS_LENGTH#, T1.ITEM_NO = GET_CODE_NO(#ITEM_NO#,'',#interCpnyID:VARCHAR#,'AR_ITEM'), T1.WORKING_HOUR = #WORKING_HOUR#, CONFIRM_FROM_TIME = #SHIFT_FROM_TIME#, CONFIRM_TO_TIME = #SHIFT_TO_TIME#, CONFIRM_MINUS_LENGTH = #MINUS_LENGTH:VARCHAR#, CONFIRM_ITEM_NO = GET_CODE_NO(#ITEM_NO#,'',#interCpnyID:VARCHAR#,'AR_ITEM'),
FINAL_CONFIRM_FROM_TIME = #SHIFT_FROM_TIME#, FINAL_CONFIRM_TO_TIME = #SHIFT_TO_TIME#, FINAL_CONFIRM_MINUS_LENGTH = #MINUS_LENGTH:VARCHAR#, FINAL_CONFIRM_ITEM_NO = GET_CODE_NO(#ITEM_NO#,'',#interCpnyID:VARCHAR#,'AR_ITEM'),
UPDATE_DATE = SYSDATE, UPDATED_BY = #adminID:VARCHAR#, UPDATED_IP = #adminIP:VARCHAR# WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (SEQ, PERSON_ID, AR_DATE_STR, SHIFT_FROM_TIME, SHIFT_TO_TIME, MINUS_LENGTH, ITEM_NO, CREATE_DATE, CREATED_BY, CREATED_IP, UPDATE_DATE, UPDATED_BY, UPDATED_IP, ACTIVITY, CONFIRM_DATE, CONFIRMD_BY, CONFIRMD_IP, CONFIRM_FROM_TIME, CONFIRM_TO_TIME, CONFIRM_MINUS_LENGTH, CONFIRM_ITEM_NO, FINAL_CONFIRM_DATE, FINAL_CONFIRMD_IP, FINAL_CONFIRM_FROM_TIME, FINAL_CONFIRM_TO_TIME, FINAL_CONFIRM_MINUS_LENGTH, FINAL_CONFIRM_ITEM_NO, WORKING_HOUR, REMARK, ALLOWANCE, TENGXUN_OT ) VALUES (AR_SHOP_SHIFT_SEQ.NEXTVAL, #PERSON_ID:VARCHAR#, #AR_DATE_STR:VARCHAR#, #SHIFT_FROM_TIME:VARCHAR#, #SHIFT_TO_TIME:VARCHAR#, #MINUS_LENGTH:VARCHAR#, GET_CODE_NO(#ITEM_NO#,'',#interCpnyID:VARCHAR#,'AR_ITEM'), SYSDATE, #adminID:VARCHAR#, #adminIP:VARCHAR#, SYSDATE, #adminID:VARCHAR#, #adminIP:VARCHAR#, 0, null, null, null, #SHIFT_FROM_TIME:VARCHAR#, #SHIFT_TO_TIME:VARCHAR#, #MINUS_LENGTH:VARCHAR#, GET_CODE_NO(#ITEM_NO#,'',#interCpnyID:VARCHAR#,'AR_ITEM'), null, null, #SHIFT_FROM_TIME:VARCHAR#, #SHIFT_TO_TIME:VARCHAR#, #MINUS_LENGTH:VARCHAR#, GET_CODE_NO(#ITEM_NO#,'',#interCpnyID:VARCHAR#,'AR_ITEM'), #WORKING_HOUR#, NULL, NULL, NULL )

) GROUP BY EMPID, LOCAL_NAME,PERSON_ID)

HISTORY.SHOP_DEPT_NO = #DEPTNO#

(SELECT HPI.NATIONALITY_CODE FROM HR_PERSONAL_INFO HPI WHERE HPI.PERSON_ID = HR.PERSON_ID) = #NATIONALITY_CODE#
HR.EMP_OFFICE = #EMP_OFFICE#
EXISTS (SELECT B1.DEPTID FROM HR_DEPARTMENT B1 WHERE B1.DEPTNO = HR.DEPTNO START WITH B1.DEPTNO in (SELECT HRD.DEPTID FROM HR_DEPARTMENT HRD WHERE HRD.MANAGER_EMP_ID = #adminID:VARCHAR#) CONNECT BY PRIOR B1.DEPTNO = B1.PARENT_DEPT_NO UNION SELECT AR_SUPERVISOR_INFO.DEPTNO FROM AR_SUPERVISOR_INFO WHERE AR_SUPERVISOR_INFO.DEPTNO = HR.DEPTNO AND AR_SUPERVISOR_INFO.PERSON_ID = #adminID:VARCHAR# )
